title: health/iosxe/YYYY-MM-DDTHH-MM-SSZ.json
description: IOS-XE lab slip (Kind observation). Written on the first visit, when something material moved against health/metadata-iosxe.json current[], or when coverage is not complete. metrics are per-device counts. readings are only the rows that moved or are abnormal this visit; the first visit writes every row and becomes baseline_ref. A reading is a board row plus an optional note. unchanged counts the board rows not in readings. vs_prior.changed is structured: one item per field that moved. No RESTCONF body. No topology: physical neighbors live on inventory/topology-observed.json.

headline.description: Quotes measurements: which subject, which field, prior -> current, since when; then the unchanged count and the ACL probe result.

scope.description: "all" when every ranked device was collected; else the device keys the task line named.

concerns.description: One device entity-ref when a metric on that device is non-zero (acls does not count). Omit healthy devices.

metrics.description: One row per collected device, scope device:<name>.

readings.description: First visit: every board row. Later visits: only rows with a changed[] item this visit, plus rows abnormal now (oper not ready, BGP not established, a counter that increased, an ACL bound on an interface but absent from the ACL GET). Not the whole estate.

unchanged.description: Count of board rows not in readings. 0 on the first visit. null when coverage is unavailable.

baseline_ref.description: health/iosxe/<baseline_visit_id>.json — the first-visit stamp that listed every subject. Null on the first visit itself.

entity_ref.description: workspace-handoff entity reference. Do not copy the referenced object. Do not invent id.

vs_prior.description: Diff of this collection against metadata current[]. First visit: prior_watch_id null, delta first, changed []. Later visits: one changed item per material field that moved.

prior_watch_id.description: metadata last_visit_id at the start of this visit.

delta.description: worse when any change lowered health (state left ready/established, a counter increased, an ACL was unbound, a peer disappeared). better when every change raised it. changed when neither (new row, ACL bound, first ACE hits).

prior.description: Prior value from the board; null when the row is new (field row).

current.description: Value this visit; null when the row disappeared (field row).

at.description: The interface's last-change when the field is state on an interface row; otherwise this visit's checked_at.

acls.description: ACLs present. 0 when the ACL GET returned 204. null when not collected.

reading.description: A board row (health-metadata-iosxe row, identical field names) plus an optional note.

name.description: Device name as inventory/prod.json writes it.

note.description: Required when the row changed this visit, is abnormal, or is mismatched (an interface names an ACL the ACL GET did not return; a WAN-role port with no BGP peer). Omit on a healthy unchanged row. The note is the nurse's opinion: what moved, since when, and what the ACL, peer, and far-end columns say about the cause. Do not repeat column values or addresses.
